study_identification.title: Capturing the Individual Deviations From Normative Models of Brain Structure for Depression Diagnosis and Treatment

study_characteristics.study_objective: Estimate normative models of regional gray matter volume (GMV) in healthy adults and use individual deviations (z-scores) to aid depression diagnosis and to identify treatment-related latent structural factors.

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Machine learning classification using NPM-derived features (e.g., with feature selection and kernel classifiers) showed better AUC (0.7146–0.7836) than models using raw GMV (0.6800–0.7036), validated on an independent external test set; Bayesian polar LDA (pLDA) identified latent structural factors associated with SSRI efficacy and contrasted SSRI vs SNRI patterns.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: Individualized deviations from normative GMV maps improve depression recognition over raw GMV and reveal latent treatment-related structural factors.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: Less than 11% overlap of extreme deviations across any region among patients, indicating high heterogeneity. Classifiers trained on NPMs achieved AUC 0.7146–0.7836 vs 0.6800–0.7036 using raw GMV, with performance verified on an external test set. pLDA revealed distinct SSRI-sensitive and SNRI-related factors with differing regional GMV patterns and associations with treatment response.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Normative modeling is cross-sectional (no longitudinal validation), age range restricted to 18–65, and further subtype expansion is suggested for improved specificity.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: Used ComBat harmonization across datasets/sites preserving age/sex/TIV; applied discretization of z-scores and polar LDA to handle deviation sign; ROI-wise normative modeling with B-spline Bayesian linear regression.

general_notes.general_notes: AAL atlas ROI-level analysis (90 regions). Preprocessing via CAT12/SPM12 with DARTEL and 8-mm smoothing; REST-meta-MDD preprocessed with DPARSF. Site differences addressed with ComBat. Reference HCs from 20 sites in REST-meta-MDD; TIV included as covariate.
